title: FP8 thermostat: staged enablement and drift mitigation for Hopper E4M3/E5M2
creator: Priya Raman
description: Goal: Enable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) safely on Hopper nodes by introducing a thermostat-style staged rollout that monitors accuracy drift and runtime stability and automatically gates/rolls back model instances. This ticket covers the orchestration glue, new telemetry signals, statistical gating logic, and a small canary pipeline for multi-model validation across representative workloads. Success criteria: (1) No >1% regression on golden prompt suite across 10 models, (2) <0.5% increase in top-level failure/retry rate during ramp, (3) automatic rollback working in at least two failure modes (accuracy drift and kernel OOM), (4) operator runbook and dashboards available.
acceptance_criteria: Thermostat circuit implemented in runtime routing and exposed in Console as a toggle
Canary job that sweeps E4M3 vs E5M2 selection for 12 representative models and reports SROCC/EM/BLEU where applicable
Telemetry: per-model token-error-rate, kernel-retries, OOMs, time-to-first-token and quantized-fingerprint drift (baseline vs 24h)
Rollback sentinel performs automatic fallback to int8/FP16 variants and emits incident ticket with debug bundle
test_plan: Unit tests for thermostat decision logic (thresholds, hysteresis)
Integration smoke: deploy to canary pool with 50 instances on Hopper E4M3 and 50 on E5M2, run golden prompt sweep every 2 hours
A/B ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% traffic steps with regression gate at each step
Chaos experiments: simulate KV cache eviction and transient kernel failures to validate rollback behavior
comments: 2026-02-20 - Priya Raman: Initial triage. Spike results show average BLEU drop of 0.6% on T5-like models when switching to naive FP8 profiles. Need thermostat to avoid broad rollouts.
2026-02-24 - Diego Martinez: Implemented prototype gating logic in runtime router. Uses moving-window SROCC and median token-likelihood delta. Pushed draft PR to runtime for core logic.
2026-02-27 - MLQA Team (review): Recommend adding golden prompt set that spans long-context and code-completion; flagged potential sensitivity to temperature sampling. Added to test_plan.

2026-03-02 - Diego Martinez: Telemetry PR adds quantized-fingerprint metric and kernel-retry counters. Deployed to staging; initial canary shows spike in kernel-retries for model 'code-gen-14b' on E4M3 at seq_len>2048.
2026-03-05 - SRE (feedback): Kernel retry spikes correlate with batch-size 8 and persistent KV cache churn. Suggest limiting batch-size and enabling per-neuron fallback for affected ops.

2026-03-07 - Diego Martinez: Updated thermostat to include operation-level blacklist and per-op hysteresis that temporarily pins to int8 for a model if op-level error rate exceeds threshold. Added integration test.

2026-03-09 - Priya Raman: Running cross-model calibration sweep across 12 models. Preliminary results: E5M2 selection slightly more stable for large decoder-only models; E4M3 better throughput for small encoder-decoder. Need to encode selection policy in scheduler.

2026-03-11 - Performance Eng: Observed 8-12% token-latency improvement on E4M3 vs E5M2 for short sequences; however for long sequences (>3k) E5M2 had fewer kernel retries. Added notes to release playbook.

2026-03-12 - Diego Martinez: Opened runtime and telemetry PRs. Requesting design review and security review (though initial assessment is no new key material). Seeking owner's sign-off to run phased canary on production-constrained pool next week.
next_steps: Finalize SLO thresholds, add canary runbook to Console, schedule production canary on low-risk pool, and complete operator training. If canary shows >1% regression, thermostat will automatically roll back to runtime-1.19 profiles and create incident for manual investigation.
